entries.9b1a0c6f3a2850e2: The company's basic policy is to establish an integrated food manufacturing-and-sales structure, and it states that it will also actively pursue M&A so that it can carry out everything from raw material procurement to development and sale of original products in an integrated way. Its medium-term vision aims for continued growth of the business centered on Gyomu Super by strengthening private brand products, and its basic policies are “expanding the restaurant and takeout business,” “strengthening domestic PB product production capacity” and “continued growth of Gyomu Super.”

entries.cdc9bef2736d7fc3: Leveraging the low-cost system built through Gyomu Super, from raw materials to products, this business operates eating-out and take-out stores on both a directly operated and a franchise basis. It operates three formats: the large buffet restaurant Kobe Cook World Buffet, the yakiniku order-buffet restaurant Premium Karubi, and the prepared-food store Chisōna. As of October 31, 2025, there were 19 Kobe Cook World Buffet stores, 22 Premium Karubi stores and 149 Chisōna stores.

entries.e46bbd21dd46b358: A distinctive feature is its structure that handles everything from procurement and product development to manufacturing at its own group factories and sales in stores. It offers in-house private brand products and directly imported goods, and attracts general customers with a range of large-volume and semi-processed products aimed at business use, backed by low pricing.
entries.e5b3b768635924b9: The company plans, develops and procures products sold at Gyomu Super stores; private brand products are manufactured at factories of consolidated subsidiaries in Japan and overseas, and are also imported directly from partner factories overseas.
entries.eb1f099bc10d069b: “Gyomu Super” initially targeted business users, but most of its customers are now general consumers. Stores operating under franchise agreements and area license agreements have spread nationwide, and the company also operates directly run stores.
entries.f259c69cee450c08: As of October 31, 2025, there were 1,122 Gyomu Super stores, and in 2021 the company achieved store openings in all 47 prefectures. Of net sales of ¥551,701 million for the fiscal year ended October 2025, the Gyomu Super Business accounted for the majority at ¥530,509 million, the Restaurant and Takeout Business ¥16,474 million and the Eco Renewable Energy Business ¥4,669 million.
entries.f33d34deab17879d: It earns net sales through wholesale of products to franchise stores and retail sales at company-operated stores.
entries.fc645c8e8b56f2ed: This is the group’s core business, serving as the franchise headquarters of the food supermarket “Gyomu Super,” planning, developing and procuring products, and also producing food at consolidated subsidiaries in Japan and overseas. It offers ingredients in the quantities, sizes and quality that customers require, and operates under the E.D.L.P (Every Day Low Price) pricing policy. Products consist of national brand products from manufacturers and private brand products made at the group’s own factories or directly imported from partner factories, and are characterized by a high proportion of semi-processed products that require a final cooking step. As of October 31, 2025, the number of stores was 1,122 in total, consisting of 713 franchise-contract stores, 405 area-license-contract stores and 4 directly operated stores. Also, “Gyomu Super” is a trademark of the company.
